acceptanceCriteria: Dependents are derived from model associations (dependent: options), foreign keys and after_create/after_commit callbacks where statically resolvable, with provenance 'derived' distinct from 'declared'; unresolved sources keep findings advisory.
Actions carry instance identity where the test binds one (variable or let name), so deleting one dependent instance does not clear others of the same kind.
Fixture tests for both, plus one real Rails app measurement.
body: Residual from V1-1884 (PR #1179, TSA-V0-110..119). Only the corvint-side-effect-declaration/0 file feeds the graph; ActiveRecord associations (has_many dependent:), foreign keys in schema.rb/migrations and callbacks are not read, so undeclared dependents are never found. There is also no instance-level identity: one dependent delete clears every action of that kind.
title: Teardown dependents: derive the side-effect graph from the system under test (models, associations, schema/migrations) instead of the declaration only
